title: feat(nmxe2): own incoming set on #7195: reverse fails, face fails
science: On the four #7195 y-probes of the x-axis opposite +/-e_2 process, the probe's own earliest incoming set M gives reverse fail and face fail, against reverse HOLD and face HOLD for the same cell read through the same-tick six-neighbour star S^+. The runner reproduces the S^+ HOLD/HOLD and records that that HOLD does not use L(A) and does not use a singleton M(A).
